evidence.quote: private readonly bookings = new Map<string, Booking>();

responsibilities.description: Stores bookings in memory, gives each new booking a unique id, and saves updates to existing bookings.
responsibilities.name: Booking storage and identity assignment

responsibilities.description: Keeps an index of bookings for each session, so a session's bookings can be fetched quickly, for example to check availability.
responsibilities.name: Session booking index

responsibilities.description: Encodes the business rule that a booking is active when its status is pending or paid, and finds a member's active bookings for a given month.
responsibilities.name: Active booking rule for a membership's month

responsibilities.description: Finds bookings still waiting for payment, for example so expired ones can be released.
responsibilities.name: Pending booking lookup
